text:
Nina (Sales): quick heads-up—FinConnect asked to onboard LibertyLM for their pilot. Need AP-SOUTH-1 availability + version pin to 1.2.0, plus a fallback to the quantized 1.2.0-q if full precision isn't available. They also want Private deployment later.
Sam (Product): thanks Nina. who’s the contact? rough qps and latency SLOs? any data residency requirements?
Nina (Sales): contact is priya@finconnect.com. target 40 qps peak, p95 latency < 400ms. must keep data in india (so AP-SOUTH-1 or on-prem).
Ellie (Customer Success): FinConnect has PCI-adjacent data. they prefer dedicated or VPC private control plane. will need SOC2 + audit log retention details.
Murat (Infra): quick infra check: LibertyLM-1.2.0 not currently packaged for AP-SOUTH-1. build/quant step exists but we need GPU capacity (A10G/RTX6000) in that region. fallback to 1.2.0-q in other regions possible.
deploy-bot: catalog-check LibertyLM-1.2.0 -> "not available in ap-south-1"; 1.2.0-q -> "available in ap-south-1 via quant pool (limited)"
Sam (Product): options: 1) schedule pin + build for ap-south-1 (ETA 2 weeks) + reserved capacity; 2) allow geo-fallback to 1.2.0-q with canary for traffic under 10 qps; 3) offer Private deploy (on-prem/VPC) — longer lead. Which does Sales want to prioritize?
Nina (Sales): Priya asked for fastest path that meets residency. she prefers option 2 as stopgap while we enable option 1. wants explicit rollout plan + rollback criteria.
Murat (Infra): rollout plan idea: canary in ap-south with 5% traffic to 1.2.0-q, monitor token-level latency/errors for 24h, then promote. rollback if error-rate > 2% or p95 degrades > 2x. I'll pre-provision one quant pool node.
Sam (Product): adding acceptance criteria for backlog: - model packaged and verified in ap-south-1 (or clear fallback) - end-to-end test with their sample prompts (provided by Priya) - canary policy and rollback thresholds documented - infra cost estimate and RU for sales.
Ellie (Customer Success): I'll request sample prompt set + data residency signoff from legal. Priya expects a short SLA note for pilot (no hard SLA, but we should promise escalation and 99% availability target).
Nina (Sales): ok I'll send Priya the proposed plan and ask for sample prompts and pilot dates. tagging @Sam and @Murat for any follow-ups. :+1:
Sam (Product): captured. I'll create a product-intake ticket with the acceptance criteria and link to this thread. prioritize as P1 for pilot readiness.
Murat (Infra): note — if we need full-precision in ap-south long-term, we'll need to add one A100-equivalent node; I'll include cost delta in the ticket.
deploy-bot: ticket created: PROD-3471 "LibertyLM 1.2.0 AP-SOUTH pin + fallback plan" — assignees Sam, Murat, Ellie.
Sam (Product): awesome. closing thread for now; updates in PROD-3471. thanks team. :rocket:
